description: Internal header for Curve25519 elliptic curve cryptography implementation in BoringSSL, defining data structures, function prototypes, and macros related to field elements, group elements, and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: x25519_ge_tobytes
methods.description: Serializes a group element to bytes.

methods.name: x25519_ge_frombytes_vartime
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into a group element, variable time.

methods.name: x25519_ge_p3_to_cached
methods.description: Converts a ge_p3 element to cached form.

methods.name: x25519_ge_p1p1_to_p2
methods.description: Converts a ge_p1p1 element to ge_p2 form.

methods.name: x25519_ge_p1p1_to_p3
methods.description: Converts a ge_p1p1 element to ge_p3 form.

methods.name: x25519_ge_scalarmult_small_precomp
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication with precomputed table.

methods.name: x25519_ge_scalarmult_base
methods.description: Scalar multiplication of the base point.

methods.name: x25519_ge_scalarmult
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of a group element.

methods.name: x25519_sc_reduce
methods.description: Reduces a 64-byte scalar modulo group order.
